findings.evidence: `upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Probability/HasLaw.lean:112` `lemma HasLaw.comp (hY : HasLaw Y ν μ) (hX : HasLaw X μ P) : HasLaw (Y ∘ X) ν P`, whose proof is the same `map_map_of_aemeasurable` argument written at InverseTransform.lean:217.
findings.fix: `rw [hcomp]; exact (hasLaw_neg_log_one_sub_div hr).comp ⟨by fun_prop, map_one_sub_restrict_Icc⟩` — the inner `HasLaw` for `u ↦ 1 - u` is exactly `map_one_sub_restrict_Icc` plus `fun_prop`.
findings.issue: `hasLaw_neg_log_div` hand-rolls composition of laws: it rebuilds the `AEMeasurable` side condition (`hg`, `hT`) and applies `AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable` manually, duplicating `ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw.comp`.

findings.evidence: `Set.preimage_const_sub_Icc` is `to_additive` of `Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Group/Pointwise/Interval.lean:311-313` `@[to_additive (attr := simp)] preimage_const_div_Icc : (fun x => a / x) ⁻¹' Icc b c = Icc (a / c) (a / b)`; it is used at `:502`. `MeasurePreserving.restrict_preimage` is `Mathlib/Dynamics/Ergodic/MeasurePreserving.lean:77`.
findings.fix: `have hpre : (fun u : ℝ => 1 - u) ⁻¹' Icc (0:ℝ) 1 = Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by simp` (or `by norm_num` after `Set.preimage_const_sub_Icc`). Alternatively drop the lemma body entirely and use `(volume.measurePreserving_sub_left 1).restrict_preimage measurableSet_Icc`.
findings.issue: `hpre` in `map_one_sub_restrict_Icc` recomputes a preimage of `Icc` under `1 - ·` with `ext`/`linarith` although it is a Mathlib `simp` lemma.

findings.evidence: `EpsilonEridani/QFT/Shower/EmissionScale.lean:236-238` proves the same kind of statement with `rw [..., ← Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hu.1, ..., ← div_le_iff₀ hr]; constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith`; `Real.le_log_iff_exp_le`/`Real.log_le_iff_le_exp` are iffs (`Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Log/Basic.lean:161,165`).
findings.fix: Replace with an iff-rewrite chain, e.g. `rw [div_le_iff₀ hr, neg_le, ← Real.le_log_iff_exp_le h1u, ...]` then `constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith`, mirroring `isQuantileFunction_emissionCdf_const`.
findings.issue: In the `0 ≤ x` branch, the iff is proved by two 4-line blocks that each introduce an anonymous `have := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le _).1/.2` and finish with `linarith`, obscuring that both directions are one rewrite chain. The PR's own analogue does it in three lines.

findings.evidence: `EpsilonEridani/QFT/Shower/Sudakov.lean:138` already states `sudakov_le_one` in integral form "so that no integrability hypothesis is needed"; the PR moved `continuous_sudakov`/`hasDerivAt_sudakov` there (Sudakov.lean:144,159) on the same reasoning, while these two facts about the factor itself stayed inline.
findings.fix: Add `one_le_sudakov (h : ∫ s in t..T, K s ≤ 0) : 1 ≤ sudakov K t T` (dual of `sudakov_le_one`) and `tendsto_sudakov_atBot (hdiv : Tendsto (fun t => ∫ s in t..T, K s) atBot atTop) : Tendsto (fun t => sudakov K t T) atBot (𝓝 0)` to `Sudakov.lean`, and call them here.
findings.issue: Two reusable properties of `sudakov` are proved inline instead of beside `sudakov_le_one`: `emissionCdf_of_ge` proves `1 ≤ sudakov K x T` through the 5-lemma chain `rw [sudakov, Real.one_le_exp_iff, neg_nonneg, intervalIntegral.integral_symm, neg_nonpos]`, and `setIntegral_Iic_sudakov_density`'s `hzero` (line 143) proves `Tendsto (fun t => sudakov K t T) atBot (𝓝 0)` by a `simpa [sudakov, Function.comp_def]` that unfolds the definition in the middle of the main proof.

findings.evidence: EmissionScale.lean:23 advertises `emissionLaw K T (Iic x) = ENNReal.ofReal (sudakov K x T)` for `x ≤ T`; grep shows no such declaration — only `hmass` at line 164, invoked at lines 171 and 176.
findings.fix: Promote it to `emissionLaw_Iic_of_le (hK) (hK0) (hdiv) (hy : y ≤ T) : emissionLaw K T (Iic y) = ENNReal.ofReal (sudakov K y T)` and have `emissionLaw_Iic` (and the `x > T` branch) apply it.
findings.issue: The headline step `emissionLaw K T (Iic y) = ENNReal.ofReal (sudakov K y T)` for `y ≤ T` — the composition of `setIntegral_Iic_sudakov_density` with `ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal` — is an inner `have hmass`, used twice in the proof and nowhere available afterwards, although the module docstring advertises it as the statement of the file.

summary: Proofs are mostly readable, but three places hand-roll library plumbing or hide reusable steps: `hasLaw_neg_log_div` reimplements `HasLaw.comp`, `isQuantileFunction_cdf_expMeasure` does a 14-line two-way inequality argument the PR elsewhere does as a single iff chain, and the Sudakov-specific facts (`1 ≤ sudakov`, `sudakov → 0`) are proved inline as rewrite chains instead of beside `sudakov_le_one`.
